editorial.blurb: Andros Taverna brings vibrant, meticulously crafted Greek cuisine to Logan Square with service that feels genuinely welcoming and attentive.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for happy hour at the bar for excellent oysters and discounted drinks, then settle in for dinner when the kitchen really shines—the mezze collection and crispy kataifi cheese pie are worth the wait, and the baklava froyo is a must-order finish.
